notes: One logical two-leg completed-week oil/gas body/range-efficiency divergence reversion package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, paired costs, and density; neither leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA independently divides each leg's absolute completed-week open-to-close body by its weekly high-low range, requires one efficiency strictly above two-thirds and the other strictly below one-third, fades the high-efficiency leg's body direction, targets equal absolute notionals, and caps aggregate frozen-stop risk at one RISK_FIXED budget.
